title: Fleet Volume Pricing — Kessler Care Fleet 12-Visit Plans
content:
# Fleet Volume Pricing

Within the Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans, fleet plans are priced on the customer's fleet volume.

1. **Threshold clause.** When the customer's active Kessler Care Fleet 12-Visit plans, counted with the plan being sold included, reach the tier's fleet volume threshold, the new plan is sold at the retail plan price less the fleet volume discount, rounded to the cent.
2. Plans sold before the threshold was reached are not repriced.
3. Tiers whose fleet volume threshold is 0 carry no fleet volume discount.
4. The fleet volume discount is not combined with the bundle discount; fleet plans carry no bundle discount.

The count is taken at the handling date. It is the customer's Kessler Care Fleet 12-Visit plans in active status, plus the plan being sold.

**Status of clause 1.** Clause 1 is **no longer in force** for a fleet plan addendum within the scope of the fleet addendum pricing rule: a Kessler Care Fleet 12-Visit plan addendum that a fleet customer buys on its own for the unit delivered on its single Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement standing in delivered status. Such an addendum takes the fleet addendum price instead. For it, plans sold earlier are still not repriced and fleet plans still carry no bundle discount. Every other fleet plan sale keeps the fleet volume threshold of clause 1.

## Threshold cases (hypothetical counts, under clause 1)

| Active fleet plans before the sale | Count with the new plan | Threshold reached (threshold of 10)? |
|---|---|---|
| 8 | 9 | No: retail plan price |
| 9 | 10 | Yes: retail plan price less the fleet volume discount |
| 14 | 15 | Yes |

Hypothetical arithmetic under clause 1: a hypothetical price of 1,250.00 less a 0.08 discount is 1,150.00. The inputs are invented.
